sys_hub_flow.description:
This flow will wait for a tracker to complete its progress on the provided instance and return the results of the tracker.

Inputs:

  • Progress Id - Sys Id of the sys_execution_tracker record.
  • Instance URL - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the test suite .
  • Credential Alias - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role.
  • Interval - The time that the 'Action' in this flow periodically checks the progress of the tracker. You can add the interval either in days or hours or minutes or seconds. Default to 30 seconds.
  • API Version - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified. When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.

Outputs:

  • Status - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled".
  • Error - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
  • HTTP Status - The HTTP status code of the response
  • Status Label - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"
  • Status Message - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Status Detail - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Percent Complete - The percentage of the operation completed.
  • Stash ID - The sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record. Can be used to uniquely identify a stash from the sys_repo_stash records.
  • Stash URL - The URL of REST endpoint to apply the stashed changes from sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record.
  • Result ID - Unique identifier of the results information. Use this value when calling the associated results endpoint.
  • Result URL - The URL of REST endpoint to obtain the results of the endpoint execution, such as results.

Error Messages:

  • User does not have access to CICD role
  • Invalid Progress ID
  • Unable to get the execution progress for the Progress Id

To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above. Learn More

sys_hub_flow_snapshot.description:
This flow will wait for a tracker to complete its progress on the provided instance and return the results of the tracker.

Inputs:

  • Progress Id - Sys Id of the sys_execution_tracker record.
  • Instance URL - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the test suite .
  • Credential Alias - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role.
  • Interval - The time that the 'Action' in this flow periodically checks the progress of the tracker. You can add the interval either in days or hours or minutes or seconds. Default to 30 seconds.
  • API Version - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified. When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.

Outputs:

  • Status - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled".
  • Error - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
  • HTTP Status - The HTTP status code of the response
  • Status Label - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"
  • Status Message - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Status Detail - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Percent Complete - The percentage of the operation completed.
  • Stash ID - The sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record. Can be used to uniquely identify a stash from the sys_repo_stash records.
  • Stash URL - The URL of REST endpoint to apply the stashed changes from sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record.
  • Result ID - Unique identifier of the results information. Use this value when calling the associated results endpoint.
  • Result URL - The URL of REST endpoint to obtain the results of the endpoint execution, such as results.

Error Messages:

  • User does not have access to CICD role
  • Invalid Progress ID
  • Unable to get the execution progress for the Progress Id

         <p><b>Inputs:</p>
         </b>
         <ul>
         <li><b>Progress Id</b> - Sys Id of the sys_execution_tracker record.</li>
         <li><b>Instance URL</b> - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the test suite .</li>
         <li><b>Credential Alias</b> - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role.</li>
         <li><b>Interval</b> - The time that the 'Action' in this flow periodically checks the progress of the tracker. You can add the interval either in days or hours or minutes or seconds. Default to 30 seconds.</li>
         <li><b>API Version</b> - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified.  When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.</li>
         </ul>
         <p><b>Outputs:</p>
         </b>
         <ul>
         <li><b>Status</b> - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled".</li>
         <li><b>Error</b> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.</li>

         <li><b>Status Detail</b> - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
         <li><b>Percent Complete</b> - The percentage of the operation completed.</li>
         <li><b>Stash ID</b> - The sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record. Can be used to uniquely identify a stash from the sys_repo_stash records.</li>
         <li><b>Stash URL</b> - The URL of REST endpoint to apply the stashed changes from sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record.</li>
         <li><b>Result ID</b> - Unique identifier of the results information. Use this value when calling the associated results endpoint.</li>
         <li><b>Result URL</b> - The URL of REST endpoint to obtain the results of the endpoint execution, such as results.</li>

         <p><b>Inputs:</p>
         </b>
         <ul>
         <li><b>Progress Id</b> - Sys Id of the sys_execution_tracker record.</li>
         <li><b>Instance URL</b> - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the test suite .</li>

         <li><b>API Version</b> - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified.  When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.</li>
         </ul>
         <p><b>Outputs:</p>
         </b>
         <ul>

         <li><b>Error</b> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.</li>
         <li><b>HTTP Status</b> - The HTTP status code of the response</li>
         <li><b>Status Label</b> - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"</li>
         <li><b>Status Message</b> - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
         <li><b>Status Detail</b> - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
